name: Zajchik: Ovech'ja Shkura
source:
It is hard to live in a world where you don't know what will happen to you tomorrow. Or not even tomorrow - in just a few hours! When you have no idea what is lurking under your bed, in the old dusty closet, or in the deep forest...

A schoolboy, barely a teenager, with no clear understanding of the cruel world around him, faced with strange, inexplicable circumstances. A premonition of something... something that terrifies not so much the mind, but the soul. The wilds of the taiga, gloom and emptiness, the scent of fireworks and sweets, stale everyday life, and a choice - perhaps the most important one of a lifetime.

[url=/c153593]Igor'[/url] will have to learn the hard way what happens to other missing children, and try to avoid the dangers lying in wait for him in this Harsh Reality.

Read and immerse yourself in this unique atmosphere! Just try not to think about being watched for the next couple of days... They feed on fear...

[Translated from [url=https://vk.com/heartflyteam?w=club226459647]VK[/url]]
translation:
生活在一个你不知道明天会发生什么的世界里是很困难的。或者甚至不是明天——只需几个小时！当你不知道你的床底下、布满灰尘的旧衣柜里或森林深处潜藏着什么时……

一个刚刚十几岁的男孩，对周围残酷的世界没有清晰的认识，面临着奇怪的、莫名其妙的情况。某种预感……某种令心灵恐惧的东西。针叶林的荒野、阴郁和空虚、烟花和糖果的香味、陈腐的日常生活，以及一个选择——也许是一生中最重要的一个。

[url=/c153593]伊戈尔[/url]将不得不经历其他失踪儿童的遭遇，并尽力避免在这个严酷的现实中等待着他的危险。

阅读并沉浸在这种独特的氛围中！在接下来的几天里尽量不要去想被监视的事情……他们以恐惧为食……
